name: Omni Video Gen
tagline: Omni Video Gen is a Gemini Omni-focused AI Video Generator for turning text prompts, reference images, and video ideas into cinematic clips
description: Omni Video Gen is a Gemini Omni-focused AI Video Generator for turning text prompts, reference images, and video ideas into cinematic clips. It supports text-to-video, image-to-video, video remixing, templates, and natural-language editing workflows for creators exploring Gemini Omni style AI video generation.
